description: Source code for tlRestApi class providing RESTful API endpoints for TestLink's test management, including project, test case, test plan, and execution management.

classes.name: tlRestApi
classes.description: Class implementing RESTful API endpoints for managing test projects, test cases, test plans, test suites, and test executions within TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the API, sets up routes, and database connections.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on provided API key from request headers.

methods.name: whoAmI
methods.description: Returns information about the current API user.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves list of test projects accessible to the authenticated user or a specific project by ID or name.

methods.name: getProjectTestPlans
methods.description: Gets all test plans for a given project.

methods.name: getProjectTestCases
methods.description: Fetches the latest version of test cases for a given project.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project from provided JSON data.

methods.name: createTestCaseExecution
methods.description: Creates a new test case execution record, validating environment and permissions.

methods.name: checkExecutionEnvironment
methods.description: Checks and validates whether the environment for executing a test case is valid.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan from JSON data.

methods.name: updateTestPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing test plan identified by ID.

methods.name: createTestSuite
methods.description: Creates a new test suite from JSON data.

methods.name: createTestCase
methods.description: Creates a new test case, setting default management info, and validating relationships.

methods.name: getUserID
methods.description: Retrieves user ID based on login name (currently unimplemented).

methods.name: createTestCaseDefaultManagement
methods.description: Sets default author ID and steps for a test case object.

methods.name: checkRelatives
methods.description: Validates relationships between test project and suite IDs.
